narrative.overview: Vesqen should feel like a listening instrument used in a dim train carriage, a quiet study, or a softly lit room: the screen recedes until a meaningful state changes. The dark experience is the primary expression, while the light experience is a complete daylight counterpart—not a separate brand. The protected full player uses the near-neutral Nocturne Graphite material ladder; genuine album artwork may contribute only a restrained, protected reflection behind that ladder. Navigation, text, and evidence labels remain stable and legible.
keyCharacteristics: Dark-first and light-complete, with identical hierarchy and behavior.
One moss signal color used sparingly for active controls, selection, and positive evidence above neutral playback states.
Soft tonal separation instead of hard divider lines or nested card grids.
Nocturne Graphite material only on the protected full player; real album artwork may contribute a restrained reflection only behind its opaque contrast layer.
Familiar Android navigation and controls, with advanced evidence one deliberate tap away.

rules.name: The Three-Destination Rule
rules.body: Top-level navigation is Library, Now, and Chain. Settings and track details are secondary destinations and never become additional permanent tabs.

rules.name: The Progressive Proof Rule
rules.body: The track list contains title, artist, artwork, playback state, and overflow only. Format, path, source parameters, route evidence, and live metrics belong in track details, Now, or Chain.

rules.name: The Evidence Hierarchy Rule
rules.body: SYSTEM MIXED and DIRECT SUPPORTED use neutral chips. AVAILABLE uses a Moss outline and open icon, ACTIVE uses a filled Moss chip and activity dot, and VERIFIED uses an outlined or tonal badge with a shield and exact device-matrix context. Color never promotes evidence by itself.

rules.name: The Chain Empty-State Rule
rules.body: Without a playback session, Chain explains that evidence appears after playback starts and offers one primary action back to Library.

rules.name: The Localized Navigation Rule
rules.body: Library, Now, and Chain are stable semantic IDs. English uses those labels; Simplified Chinese displays 曲库, 正在播放, and 链路.

rules.name: The Signal Budget Rule
rules.body: Signal Moss occupies no more than roughly 10% of an ordinary screen. Its rarity creates recognition and makes active state unambiguous.

rules.name: The Stable Truth Rule
rules.body: Android dynamic color is not enabled in the v1.0 baseline. If it is added later, output states keep fixed semantic roles: brand, warning, error, and proof meanings never inherit an arbitrary wallpaper hue.

rules.name: The One-Family Rule
rules.body: UI labels, buttons, track metadata, and navigation use the same sans-serif family. Monospace never leaks into the ordinary library or primary controls.

rules.name: The No-Line Rule
rules.body: Separate list items with rhythm, alignment, and surface tone. Hard dividers are limited to dense technical tables where row tracking genuinely requires them.

rules.name: The Opaque Fallback Rule
rules.body: If blur, transparency, performance, or contrast cannot be guaranteed, render a fully opaque semantic surface without changing layout or affordance.

rules.name: The Focused Player Material Rule
rules.body: Now uses Canvas #101415, Dock #191F20, Raised #202728, and Artwork Frame #252C2D. A real cover may be blurred 36dp at 22% alpha behind an 82% Canvas scrim, leaving 3.96% visible reflection. Missing or unreadable artwork remains opaque; Moss stays action-only.

rules.name: The Single Player Lift Rule
rules.body: The Now transport dock is separated by one 20dp ambient-plus-spot shadow only. It has no hard divider, border, glow, gradient, glass treatment, or competing elevation cue.

dos: Do keep Library, Now, and Chain stable across themes and window sizes.
Do keep Signal Moss below roughly 10% of ordinary screen area and reserve it for identity, focus, selection, and positive evidence above neutral playback states.
Do maintain at least WCAG 2.2 AA contrast, 48dp touch targets, TalkBack labels, scalable text, and reduced-motion behavior.
Do use soft tonal transitions, restrained artwork light, and platform blur only when they clarify elevation or playback context.
Do disclose technical detail progressively and preserve evidence confidence labels in Chain and detail surfaces.
Do use the symmetric Twin Paths V mark inside the Android adaptive-icon safe zone and provide a dedicated monochrome layer.
donts: Don't build a feed-heavy streaming surface with recommendations, social activity, advertising, or engagement loops.
Don't imitate Spotify, NetEase Cloud Music, Apple Music, or another recognizable player.
Don't use neon gaming-audio dashboards, spectrum visualizer spectacle, or dense audiophile telemetry on the default screen.
Don't use generic glassmorphism, decorative blur, oversized rounded-card grids, purple-gradient dark mode, or animation without a state purpose.
Don't use music notes, headphones, play triangles, vinyl records, waveforms, or checkmarks as the product mark.
Don't let Android dynamic color change the Vesqen mark or semantic playback state.
Don't style SYSTEM MIXED or DIRECT SUPPORTED as Moss success states.
Don't pair a decorative border with a wide soft shadow, use side-stripe accents, gradient text, or card radii above 16dp.
